text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered (P0) — GPU capacity exhaustion in prod-us-west-2. Symptoms: inference queue growth, elevated 503s. Oncall: @sanjay. Runbook: https://rwd.in/runbooks/gpu-capacity

sanjay: ack, I'm on it. seeing queue ~18k for the inference service, spikes across multiple routes. tagging eng-sre. :rotating_light:

sanjay: quick check: kubectl get pods -n inference | grep Pending -> lots of Pending with messages like "0/1 nodes are available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu" and "node(s) didn't match node selector"

lia: looking at cluster-autoscaler logs (prod-usw2). seeing repeated failures to provision new GPU nodes: 
```
scale-up: request ignored for availability-zone us-west-2b: launchTemplateVersionMismatch
Error: failed to attach instance profile: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole
```

jordan: I pushed a launch-template update ~25m ago to roll in a new AMI and user-data. rolling LT change may have removed the instance profile binding by mistake. checking LT versions now. cc @eng-platform

amelia: confirmed from ASG events: new instances are spinning but failing bootstrap due to attach role missing. kubelet bootstrap logs show: "failed to get credentials: AccessDenied for iam:PassRole". cluster-autoscaler tries to create nodes but they don't register properly.

sanjay: sounds like autoscaler requests are created but nodes either don't join or join tainted/unusable. what's our fastest mitigation? manual capacity increase?

maya: taking over oncall from @sanjay for remediation. I'll manually scale the ASG to buy runway. setting desired to 6.

maya: running: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-prod-usw2 --desired-capacity 6`

ops-bot: action: asg-desired-change executed by maya — gpu-pool-prod-usw2 desired=6 -> initiated. runbook: https://rwd.in/runbooks/scale-up-manual

lia: creating a temporary nodegroup with LT v42 (the last known-good) to avoid the missing instance-profile. spinning an explicit nodegroup now.

jordan: I've started rollback of launch template to v42 and re-applied the instance profile `arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-attach-role`. Will push as LT v43 -> v42 revert.

sanjay: once nodes register we should drain pending pods onto them. sequence: 1) wait for Node Ready, 2) kubectl drain, 3) kubectl delete pod to requeue.

amelia: small wrinkle: new nodes are showing a taint `gpu:reserved=true:NoSchedule` in the bootstrap; some pods don't tolerate that key (we changed taint key in the bootstrap template). I'll remove the taint temporarily: `kubectl taint nodes <node> gpu=reserved:NoSchedule-`

maya: nodes are coming up now, Ready=6. queue length dropping from 18k -> 4.2k in the last 8m. routing errors also decreasing. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: metrics update: inference 5xx rate peaked at 12% between 03:07-03:22 UTC, now at 1.3%. customer impact: degraded throughput and intermittent 503s for Dedicated customers in us-west-2 during the window.

jordan: root cause hypothesis: launch template rollout removed instance-profile/changed taint keys, causing autoscaler provisioned nodes to fail bootstrap and/or be tainted incorrectly. autoscaler saw failed attempts and hit scale limits while queue grew.

sanjay: immediate mitigation summary: manual ASG scale-up + temp nodegroup using older LT + rollback of LT to restore instance-profile + remove taints. That bought capacity and allowed pending pods to be scheduled.

maya: I'm scaling ASG back to normal autoscale desired=3 and handing to eng-sre to finish cleanup. `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-prod-usw2 --desired-capacity 3`

ops-bot: action: asg-desired-change executed by maya — gpu-pool-prod-usw2 desired=3.

jordan: creating incident ticket and assigning owners: postmortem owners: jordan (launch-template change), maya (mitigation/oncall), sanjay (customer comms). tagging @product for impacted customers.

sanjay: drafting customer notice now, will post to status page and email affected enterprise reps. ETA 30m.

amelia: follow-up items: 1) add LT pre-deploy CI check to validate instance profile & taint keys, 2) autoscaler should surface attach/PassRole errors in alerts, 3) add quota buffer to ASG policy for GPU pools.

maya: incident mitigated, handing to eng-sre to run RCA and postmortem. set P0 -> mitigated, open postmortem due by EOD tomorrow.

sanjay: assigning postmortem ticket (#INC-614159) to owners, linking logs and commands used. thanks all for quick response. :heart:
